context.issue: Owner field format error in lending request creation
context.explanation: The 'owner' field must be a plain string, NOT wrapped in {value: ...} format. The official JSON schema and XSD define owner as a plain string, so this matches the documentation (corrected 2026-11-12, see references/evaluation.md RS-02; this 400 body is historical and was not re-run).
context.solution: Use plain string format: 'owner': 'MAIN' instead of 'owner': {'value': 'MAIN'}
